subject: Request: Long-term rate anchoring + exit protection for Acme Tech
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@acmetech.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@acmetech.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Multi-year economics request — price lock + exit protection

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We are evaluating a 3-year commitment across multiple product lines and have a couple of procurement asks before we take this to our CPO. Two things are important for us: a firm price lock for 36 months (no per-token uplift > the agreed rate) and a clean exit protection if our usage materially drops below the baseline after year 1 (we need an option to unwind with a predefined floor).

Quick asks: can Redwood provide: 1) price lock language and an explicit annual uplift cap (we'd like max 3% per year), and 2) an exit protection clause that limits termination liability to committed minimums or pro-rated credits?

I've attached the RFP and expected usage profile. If you send proposed contract bullets we can loop in legal (cc'd Priya). We're targeting an internal approval meeting on July 6.

Best,
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Tech

Attachments: Acme_RFP_v2.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@acmetech.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@acmetech.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year economics request — price lock + exit protection

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Acme's RFP and asks. High level: they want a 36-month anchor with a hard uplift cap (they propose 3%/yr) and an exit protection mechanism that limits cost if usage drops materially (they want termination with limited liability / pro-rated credits). They are a strategic account — potential $2.8M ARR if we win.

Current thinking from sales: we can offer a price lock for the first 24 months at negotiated rates, then graduated increases thereafter, but Acme insisted on a hard cap across the full term. Deal Desk, is 3%/yr acceptable under our guardrails for this tier? Also need to align on exit mechanics: typical Redwood approach is pro-rated credits for unused committed tokens with a 60–90 day notice and a 12-month minimum commitment to avoid churn exposure.

Please advise suggested language and any needed exec approvals. Samir, attaching a draft SOW and rate table we can start from.

Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft_SOW_Acme.docx, RateTable_Acme.xlsx
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@acmetech.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@acmetech.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year economics request — price lock + exit protection

Karthik —

Thanks for the context. Deal Desk POV below. We reviewed their usage profile and the $2.8M ARR projection. Two recommendations to balance revenue predictability and commercial flexibility:

- Price lock: approve a full 36-month price lock if Acme agrees to a staged commit schedule: 60% year1 minimum, 85% cumulative year2, 100% billed year3. If they sign a flat 3-year commitment (signed SOW + payment terms), we can cap uplift at 2.5%/yr (we should push back from 3%).

- Exit protection: propose pro-rated credits for unused committed tokens through month 12; allow a unilateral termination after 12 months with a 6-month termination liability (i.e., customer pays 50% of remaining committed fees), but include a true-up clause if usage rebounds. This gives us downside protection while addressing their need for an exit path.

- Security/legal: ask Legal to accept a narrow carve-out for force-majeure usage drops; otherwise Acme will want broad escape clauses.

If you want exec approval for modifying uplift cap to 2.5% and the 6-month liability floor, I'll prepare a one-pager for Laura. Ben, confirm accounting/ASC40 treatment and whether finance needs revenue recognition notes for the staged commit.

Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year economics request — price lock + exit protection

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the summary and proposed guardrails. I approve the following commercial concessions on a conditional basis:

1) Price lock for 36 months with an uplift cap of 2.5%/year (not 3%).
2) Staged commit schedule as proposed (60% Y1, 85% Y2, 100% Y3 billed).
3) Exit protection limited to: pro-rated credits for unused tokens in the first 12 months, and a termination liability capped at 6 months of committed fees thereafter.

Conditions:
- Legal must sign off on the exact exit-language and ensure no open-ended escape clauses.
- Finance must confirm treatment and include necessary revenue recognition disclosures.
- Customer must accept the staged commit milestones in the SOW.

Once Legal and Finance confirm, Marissa please circulate a short amendment/terms sheet. Karthik — share this with Samir and Priya and ask them to confirm milestones by July 6.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
